source_event.finding: A-006 stale certified identity after material changes

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A readiness certificate can remain internally consistent while no longer describing the current material candidate after later changes.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Keep using an earlier readiness certificate after code, tests, documentation, or persistence artifacts change materially.
trigger_signals: certificate identity differs from frozen candidate
post-freeze path is outside the result allowlist
generalized_learning.reusable_control: Freeze the material candidate again, regenerate identity-bound readiness artifacts, and constrain later result files to an explicit allowlist.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Readiness certification occurs only after material changes are frozen; any later material change requires a new freeze and new certificate.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Compare the certified material identity with later descendants and reject readiness whenever a changed path falls outside the result-only allowlist.

transfer_cases.evidence: a post-certificate persistence change requires a new material freeze
a post-certificate material test or documentation change also requires a new freeze

skill_changes.evidence: delivery readiness requires a frozen material identity before certification
delivery readiness checks identity-bound artifacts and post-freeze path scope before handoff
